questions.prompt: Your program runs a task in JSON mode and gets exit code 0. What can you conclude?
options: The model call worked and the answer is correct
Nothing about the model call yet, because JSON mode exits 0 even when it failed
The run was aborted by the user
The reply was cut by the token limit
questions.explanation: JSON mode exits 0 even when the model call failed, so the program must read the events to learn the outcome.

questions.prompt: You send 200 tasks to one expert. Which choice avoids paying full startup 200 times?
options: Print mode with a shorter prompt
questions.explanation: Print and JSON start a new process for each task. RPC starts once and the SDK has no process to start.

questions.prompt: A task in print mode ends because the reply hit the token limit. What does the program see?
options: Exit code 0 and half an answer
No output and no exit code
Exit code 0 and an extra JSON line
questions.explanation: Print mode returns exit code 1 for an error, an abort or a reply cut by the token limit.
